claims.text: Money capital finances production, while capital goods are produced assets used in production. A choice about finance and equipment depends on the task and the resources already available.

claims.text: Money capital is finance available to acquire productive resources. Spending it on a tool converts available finance into a productive asset; it does not make the finance and the tool the same thing.

verification.method: Original Codex structural exemplar; not completed whole-subject resource text.

claims.text: Capital goods are produced assets used to make goods or services, such as a sewing machine or a workbench. Their productive use distinguishes them from money held to finance purchases.
